rationale: The bag was lost by the airline during the covered trip and was reported to the carrier, so section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects) covers it, and the claim was filed within the 90-day window. Following section 10, the eligible items come to $805 (no item exceeds the Economy $150 per-item limit; the sandals count as one item at $140), less the airline's $100 settlement, less the $100 Economy deductible, giving $605, which is under the $750 benefit maximum. The required carrier report, settlement letter and receipts are all on file and the customer has no earlier claims.
